title: Spite Store piece release file
description: A piece's release metadata, kept in pieces/<id>/release.json beside its manifest: credits, and named tracks cut from its frozen versions. Rules the schema cannot express (track ids are unique, and every track's version is recorded in the piece's versions.json) are checked by the CLI and the site build.

credits.description: People and their roles, in display order.

tracks.description: Named, fixed performances of frozen versions.

version.description: The frozen version's hash, as recorded in versions.json.

audio.description: The sha256 of the track's 24-bit FLAC, stored as <hex>.flac.

frames.description: The audio's length in frames at 48 kHz.
